subject: Post-call: roadmap fit + proposed MAP — quick prioritization check
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@neptune-analytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: roadmap fit + proposed MAP — quick prioritization check

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and the mutual action plan (attached) so we’re aligned on next steps if this is still a priority for Neptune. I kept the MAP tight to make it easy to discuss with your team:

- Objective: reduce inference latency for batch scoring and introduce a hosted pilot for customer-facing insights by Q4.
- Success metric: 50% reduction in 99th-percentile latency on your customer scoring job and <20% increase in cost per token vs current infra.
- Proposed pilot: 2-week sandbox on a dedicated pool (private project), evaluate integration complexity and end-to-end latency on a 10k record batch.
- Responsibilities:
  - Neptune: provide sample scoring job and a short sample dataset (5–10k rows).
  - Redwood: provision pilot environment, run two benchmark passes and provide a short report + recommended config.
- Timing: suggested pilot start window 10/4 — 10/18; we can move earlier if you’re comfortable with credentials and data sharing.

I attached a one-page MAP (neptune_MAP_v1.pdf) and a very short checklist for procurement/security items we’d need if you move forward. If you’re not the right owner for prioritization, please point me to who owns the data-platform/pilot decision and I’ll loop them in.

Would you say this is a P1 for Q4, something to shelve for next cycle, or not a fit? If P1, I’ll schedule a quick kickoff with Karthik (who will run the pilot) and Marissa from CS to coordinate onboarding.

Thanks — looking forward to hearing where this sits on your roadmap.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: neptune_MAP_v1.pdf (1 page — mutual action plan + quick procurement checklist)

Hi Alice —

Wanted to bump this in case it got buried. Short thread — can you tell me which of the three options below best matches Neptune’s timing so we know how to prioritize: 

A) P1 — we want to run a pilot this quarter and can assign an engineer to hand over the sample dataset
B) P2 — interesting but timing is next quarter (we should set a checkpoint for Oct)
C) Not a fit — please close the file / I’ll reopen if priorities shift

If easier, a one-line reply with A/B/C is perfect. If you want a quick 15-min sync with Karthik and Marissa to walk through the pilot checklist, we’re happy to schedule.

Thanks again — no pressure, just trying to keep our queue tidy.

Subject: Final check — shall I deprioritize and unassign this opportunity?

Hi Alice (and Samir) —

Circling back one last time on the MAP I shared a couple weeks ago. We haven’t heard back on timing and want to avoid keeping an open pilot slot when teams are full. Quick ask: if you don’t expect to run the pilot in the next 8 weeks, tell me and I’ll deprioritize the deal and remove the reserved pilot window. 

If you’re still planning to move forward, a one-line reply with “please proceed” is sufficient and we’ll keep the slot. If it’s not a priority, I’ll mark this as unassigned and we can reconnect when your roadmap firms up.

To make this ultra-simple:
- Reply with PROCEED to keep the pilot slot; or
- Reply with HOLD to set a reminder in 90 days; or
- No reply = I’ll close the file and unassign the pilot follow-up.

Appreciate the help either way — want to respect your backlog and ours.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
